assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The symptoms are contributing to the patient's cardiac conditions
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
The Holter monitor is coded CPT 93226
The study is medically necessary to characterize the recurrent symptoms in the context of the patient's documented cardiac conditions
